verdict.rationale: Jan lists 'Model Context Protocol: MCP integration for agentic capabilities' as a headline feature, indicating the app can connect to MCP servers for tool use, but there is no documentation of setup, an official MCP server list, or independent confirmation of how it works. missing for 10: detailed MCP server docs, official server directory, hands-on/independent verification, and clarity on whether MCP integration is client- or server-side.
